question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"commit".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **"Commit" **means to make a firm decision or promise to do something.
 
• The sentence suggests that the blank requires a word that is opposite in meaning to "hesitate" a
